generation.scope: Every ordinary rank-fifteen window on the entire three-adic disk 0<v(y)<3v(x) is standard Koszul, left/right AS-regular and free of rank 256 per start over four central quartics. The exact seventh quotient and two-sided residue bounds through thirteen leave potential excess only in degree nine. A three-residue-class Koszul/Euler lemma forces the missing Hilbert function and freeness. The same all-degree certificate covers integral slopes outside the zeros of an integer polynomial C with C(0) a 3-adic unit. All pencils x^3=Dy with D of positive valuation at some place over three are regular at every point, with their indexed genus-two classification for D nonzero and not 27.

proof_review.scope: Checked the signs and residues in the four-vertex Euler identity, projective dimension at most two, homogeneous depth, degree-one syzygy and descent of each central free rank.

mathematical_computation.scope: Fifteen-term rational-function H-jets through length seven at all four starts, independently checked F9 two-sided residue bounds at lengths eight through thirteen, exact homological proof of the ninth-degree gap.

tex.engine: LuaHBTeX; no overfull boxes, missing glyphs or undefined references

open_mathematics: Make the finite residue-slope obstruction in characteristic three effective. On v(y)>0 with D=x^3/y a unit at three, record the polynomial denominators and unit pivots of the F3(z) overlap certificate, descend their zero set through the degree-24 trace map, and treat any whole bad residue fibers. Use the exact seventh integral lattices and the three-residue-class criterion when extending to unrestricted v(y). The unrestricted classification still includes isolated interior points and nonsymmetric branches.
